query_normalized: systematic review of privacy-preserving federated learning protocols computer science
rationale: The paper focuses specifically on "partial client participation" challenges (e.g., generalization, robustness, fairness) rather than "privacy-preserving protocols" (e.g., differential privacy, secure multi-party computation, homomorphic encryption).
